description: Unsigned transactions that set what the factor may use: desks (treasury, runway, portfolio or sweep, or a catalog adapter address) with ceilings per move and per UTC day, or approved: false to stop it; payees with a cap in dollars per UTC day (0 removes one), each a 0x address or a stealth recipient (a fresh one-time address, approved, then announced last); the exact claim calls that bring creator fees in (Pons claim(), Bankr collectFees(poolId)), at most 1,024 bytes of calldata each; and pausing the factor. The factor's own mandate limits come with it when it is chosen. Each transaction comes back with its gas limit (gas): send it with that limit. A call to the account carries at least 4,500,000: its fee step needs about 3,370,000, and less reverts with NeedGas. Needs the owner's signed request (auth) for request "limits".

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

data.description: The exact 0x calldata of the claim call, at most 1,024 bytes.

paused.description: true pauses the factor: it cannot act until unpaused. Owner actions are never paused.

stealth.description: Instead of an address: a stealth meta-address (st:eth:0x<spending key><viewing key>) or the 0x address that registered one in the ERC-6538 registry. The money goes to a fresh one-time address and an ERC-5564 announcement is added last.

weekLossPct.description: The owner's own limit on what the factor's moves may lose together over 7 UTC days, as a percent of the account's value (0.01 to 10); the factor is held to the lower of it and its mandate's. 0 removes it.
